top_reviews.title: Tips with Pics
top_reviews.text:
Okay for all you first time
buyers or anyone who is unsure of how to buy the right size, I am a native of San Clemente which is the home of Rainbow Sandals (lived in So Cal my whole life until a couple years ago *tear, tear*). I have worn Rainbows my entire life and I can tell you that these are the best sandals you can ever purchase and the most comfortable. And they last for a long time.

That being said, for the best and most
comfortable fit when selecting a band new Rainbow sandal you want to choose one that leaves no room at back of the sandal. Basically, a sandal that is almost exactly the same size/shape of your foot give or take a centimeter or 2 on the sides and don't worry about the tightness of the straps so much, if your feet don't quite get in all the way at first - these babies stretch out ALOT. When I first buy a pair, they are very tight and my feet do not quite fit in the straps and my heel might hang off the end just a little until they are worn in. To help wear them in faster, I will wear them to the beach or pool or whenever around water and walk in the water to loosen them up.

Once these babies are worn in, they are the best and most comfortable sandal in the world... If you get properly sized.

Ps. My favorite trick (see bottom right square in photo) to stretch out the straps is to put them on and use one foot to hold down the opposite sandal at the back and lift my heel up and over my toes so that the ball of my foot digs into the sandal. I do this standing or sitting every time I wear them until they are stretched out.

Also, the reason why one of my sandals in the picture is frayed a little is because my dog kind of got to it when she was a pup going threw her crazy "let's chew on everything including the cabinets phase". As you can see, the other is still in excellent condition.
Anyway, hope this helps some people.

top_reviews.title: Fits smaller than other styles.
top_reviews.text:
I have the twisted sister and flirty braidy in the same size, (M), and color. While Rainbows generally have a painful break in, the twisted sister is worse for the first few days than the braidy. The toe strap is father back, pushing my foot back off the sandal, and leaving too much excess footbed at the toes. Also the straps are shorter, harder and tighter. Meaning I really needed to get those all the straps stretched in order to get a good fit. I added a couple comparison pics.
Though they're exactly the same length and width, the twisted sisters fit much tighter and will require more care when breaking in. Anyone with slightly thick or wide size 7 feet would be miserable in these while they broke them in. I have thin, somewhat narrow feet and I was miserable.
The GOOD: The straps actually stretched pretty quickly. After just a few days of casual wear. I got not blisters because I didn't overdo it. Then I could wear them more often and get them really broken in. They're cute, I like these, but I prefer the overall look and feel of the Flirty Braidy version. The twisted sister straps will be murder those first days. Rainbows get super soft and comfortable, so it's worth it to me.
HINT: put the flops on, get an idea of where they will rub, and then immediately put bandaids or moleskin on those areas before you ever wear them. I find the best way to break in Rainbows is just wear them, go for some long, slow walks.
Stay away from water. It ages leather no matter what.

top_reviews.title: Great shoe, break-in period not bad
top_reviews.text: When I ordered these flip flops, I was prepared to be in a significant amount of pain during the break-in period, with lots of blisters to show for it. I was pleasantly surprised when my expectations were shattered. I'm not going to lie, these were definitely a tight fit when they arrived (tight enough that they were painful, initially, and left some deep imprints on the top of my foot), but I didn't get any of the blisters that I was expecting. After the first few days of wearing them on my feet they were sufficiently stretched out that there was no longer any pain, so the break-in period really wasn't bad for me. Like I said, the straps were extremely tight when they arrived, so I just sat around with them on my feet while they stretched out. The second day I walked around the house a little (but still mostly sat), and by day three they were worn in enough that I could walk around freely in them. It's been two weeks since I got them and they are soft, comfortable, and have a really nice (light) imprint from my individual foot. There is great arch support and the foot bed is solid without feeling too stiff (if you press into it with your finger there is a little give but it's not squishy). I like that the strap is a little on the thicker side (better for walking) but still looks a little feminine with the braid. As far as size goes, I'm a 7-7.5 in most shoes and the med (6.5-7.5 I think) fit perfect. Brand new, my foot was right at the edge of the back but after a couple weeks, it seems to have stretched out a little, so don't try to size up; Get your actual size. I don't think this is an especially narrow flip flop either. I consider my foot normal to slightly wide and I have even worn narrow shoes (some flats and flip flops) that were not comfortable and I didn't have a problem with this shoe. I think it's a more normal width (maybe ever so slightly on the narrow side). Great simple looking flip flop, seems durable and made with great materials. I would definitely recommend this product. And, once again, if you aren't walking around a ton when you first get this sandal, the break-in period is really not that bad.

top_reviews.title: Elegant
top_reviews.text: Perfect fit. Shoes are a topic of conversation every time I wear them. Very comfortable and so elegant and fashionable. Material is not very firm but enough to not stretch when walking at a fast pace that you risk falling out of them. I wear with so many things in my closet from jeans to dresses.

I think it's a more normal width (maybe ever so slightly on the narrow side). Great simple looking flip flop, seems durable and made with great materials. I would definitely recommend this product. And, once again, if you aren't walking around a ton when you first get this sandal, the break-in period is really not that bad.

top_reviews.title: Elegant
top_reviews.text: Perfect fit. Shoes are a topic of conversation every time I wear them. Very comfortable and so elegant and fashionable. Material is not very firm but enough to not stretch when walking at a fast pace that you risk falling out of them. I wear with so many things in my closet from jeans to dresses.
